scope: Technical speed improvement, no visual redesign

diagnosis.pagespeed_insights: quota exceeded for unauthenticated PageSpeed Insights API at 2026-11-11T09:18:00+05:30, so this pass used bundle analysis and build output instead

before.cause: SiteSearch was statically imported by Layout and eagerly imported cmsStorage, which embeds all published markdown posts in the initial route chunk

change.summary: Lazy-load SiteSearch only after the visitor activates search; keep the same search button and panel once loaded.
change.analytics_fix: TypeScript-safe dataLayer push helper; no event-name or metadata change

after.loading_behavior: search data chunk is deferred until search is requested

/assets/cmsStorage-D2k-nbAT.js.loading: not present in initial HTML; loaded after activating search

browser_visual.result: Header, search icon, search drawer, input and results visually normal against the pre-deploy baseline.
browser_visual.first_result: July 27 Zodiac Sign: Leo Traits, Decan and Tarot Card

verification.analytics_smoke: Accepted-consent smoke test after this deployment confirmed shop_listing_open and inquiry_cta_click in dataLayer, with GTM and Clarity scripts loaded. See measurement-2026-11-11.json synthetic_analytics_events.
